name: CrowdStrike
description: CrowdStrike sells cloud-delivered cybersecurity: a single software agent on customer computers and servers (the Falcon platform) that detects attacks, plus add-on modules for cloud security, identity, log analytics and managed response. It has more than 88,000 customer organizations (January 31, 2026) and 32 modules. Customers pay an annual subscription; 95% of FY2026 revenue was subscription. Its key metric is annual recurring revenue (ARR): $5.84B at July 31, 2026, +25%. A newer 'Falcon Flex' contract lets a customer commit a dollar amount and switch between modules; Flex accounts had $2.29B of ARR (+101%). On July 19, 2024 a faulty CrowdStrike update crashed millions of Windows machines; it still incurs legal and remediation costs. Four-for-one stock split effective July 2, 2026.
